name: jp.lida.angeltoon
description: Soft two-step toon shader for URP (LidaAngelToon/Toon, LidaAngelToon/Toon Transparent): two soft shade steps, baked occlusion mask, rim, soft specular, MatCap, two-layer materials, highlight roll-off and an inverted-hull outline whose width is kept between a minimum and a maximum number of screen pixels. The shading core is shared with the Unreal Engine version.
